disposition_reason: Wheat grain selenium with and without foliar selenite, and per-gram selenium response rates for six crops on loess soil.

study.design: field biofortification trials with soil selenate, selenite, zinc sulfate and potassium iodate on six crops, plus foliar selenite and zinc on wheat
study.method: ICP-MS after HNO3-H2O2 digestion for selenium

material.label_as_printed: Winter wheat grain, no foliar selenium

findings.notes: Control of foliar selenite trial; ICP-MS.

material.label_as_printed: Winter wheat grain, foliar selenite 60 g Se/ha

non_numeric_findings: Soil selenate at 1 g Se/ha raised selenium by 17.4 ug/kg in wheat grain, 8.6 in maize grain, 17.3 in soybean, 10.2 in potato tuber, 4.1 in canola seed and 76.8 in cabbage leaf (Results).
Biofortification target used: 300 ug/kg dry weight, reached at 16, 34, 15, 28, 71 and 3 g Se/ha selenate respectively (Results).
Soil selenite was far less effective: 0.2 ug/kg per g/ha for maize, 1.2 soybean, 0.9 potato, 6.5 cabbage (Results).
Foliar selenite reached the 300 ug/kg wheat target at 59 g/ha (Results).
